mount_height_reference: Flywheel shaft center, confirmed by user
ball_diameter_basis: User reports nominal specification and typical team measurements; measure the test ball set
guide_exit_description: User identifies end of front surface at the 11.5-degree line inside the gray box
cad_geometry_assumption: Approximate edge at 20.4 mm level; actual intersection with inclined cut can differ. Concentric 106 mm guide; upward travel on the left of the wheel; CAD base horizontal. These are geometric estimates, not measured release conditions.
notes: Ring inertia assumes uniform concentric annuli. The inclined cut's 11.5 degrees is not used as the launch angle. Shaft height is confirmed; ball-center release height and actual free-flight angle still need validation.
